description:
Stop making these communication mistakes when you speak!

PREORDER MY NEW BOOK: https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect

FREE Communication Frameworks Training ➡ https://bit.ly/3NyCegg
I'll teach you 3 communication frameworks to master conversations 🗣️

We often don't realise it but our communication is the key to levelling up not just our career but every single area of our lives. It's the tide that lifts all boats.

Yet we make common communication mistakes that rob us of credibility and authority without realising it. So in this video I want to share 5 common communication mistakes that are invisible to most people and exactly how to fix them.

=== About Vinh Giang ===
Vinh Giang is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker, communication skills expert, and magician. He blends his unique talents to captivate audiences and deliver powerful lessons on the art of influence, persuasion, and effective communication. His mission is to empower individuals and leaders to communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, enabling them to unlock new levels of success in both their personal and professional lives.
